name: Multi-Repository Projects
description: Define a project model that spans multiple repositories within a workspace. Workspace state tracks which repositories are active for the current project context. Enable cross-repository operations: search across all active repos, run commands against the active set, and maintain a unified view of project state.
purpose: Real-world projects span multiple repositories (frontend, backend, shared libraries). A flat single-repository model is insufficient. Multi-repo projects enable unified tooling across repository boundaries without forcing monorepo structure.
acceptanceCriteria: A project can declare membership across multiple repositories
Workspace state tracks which repositories are active for the current project
Switching project context updates the active repository set
Cross-repository search works across all active project repositories
Commands can be scoped to run against the active repository set
Project membership metadata is persisted and survives workspace restart
A repository can belong to multiple projects
Removing a repository from a project does not detach it from the workspace
